formats.name: AI Agent Organizational Chart
formats.description: A hierarchical diagram illustrating an 'Orchestrator' managing multiple specialized AI agents, with visual connections indicating task flow, dependencies, and shared context.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a flowchart or organizational chart with distinct nodes for each AI agent and the orchestrator. Use arrows to show task handoffs and dependencies, and dotted lines for shared information or context.

formats.name: Brand Kit / Design System
formats.description: A structured presentation of a brand's visual identity, including color palettes, typography guidelines, and UI component examples, all adhering to a consistent aesthetic.
formats.rebuild_hint: Develop a design system document or web page that showcases primary and secondary color palettes, a complete type system (headings, body text, etc.), and examples of key UI components like buttons and input fields, ensuring brand consistency.

formats.name: Landing Page Hero Section
formats.description: A prominent, full-width section at the top of a webpage designed to immediately capture attention, featuring a bold headline, a clear call-to-action, and supporting text.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a hero section with a dark background, a large, impactful headline, a concise sub-headline, and a primary call-to-action button. Include navigation elements and potentially a secondary call-to-action.

formats.name: Email Newsletter Layout
formats.description: A template for email newsletters with a branded header, multiple content blocks for articles or updates, and call-to-action buttons, designed for readability and engagement.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design an email template with a dark color scheme, a clear header with branding, distinct content sections for different topics, and prominent call-to-action buttons to guide user interaction.

formats.name: Ad Creative Templates
formats.description: Reusable design patterns for digital advertisements in various aspect ratios, featuring bold headlines, concise messaging, and clear call-to-action buttons.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create ad templates for common aspect ratios (e.g., 1:1, 9:16) using a dark background, strong typography for headlines, minimal copy, and a contrasting call-to-action button to maximize visual impact.

formats.name: Course/Guide Layout with Navigation
formats.description: A common UI pattern for online courses or guides, featuring a persistent left-hand navigation menu that lists modules or sections, often with progress tracking. The main content area dynamically updates to display the selected module's information, which can include text, images, and interactive elements like prompts.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a responsive two-column layout. The left column should be a fixed-width sidebar for navigation, allowing users to toggle between modules. The right column should be the main content area, scrollable and designed to display various types of educational content. Include visual cues for progress.

formats.name: Copy-Paste Prompt Component
formats.description: A UI component designed to present actionable text prompts, typically for use with AI tools. It includes the prompt text, often with highlighted sections for user input, and a 'Copy' button to easily transfer the text to the clipboard. It may also include instructions or rules for effective use of the prompt.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a styled block or card component. Inside, include a text area or pre-formatted text block for the prompt. Add a 'Copy' button that, when clicked, copies the entire prompt text to the user's clipboard. Optionally, include instructional text or rules above/below the prompt.

formats.name: Sequential Workflow Orchestration
formats.description: A multi-step process where tasks are executed in a specific, predefined order, as illustrated by the 'Onboard New Customer' example.
formats.rebuild_hint: Define a series of sequential steps, where each step calls a specific tool or function with parameters, and subsequent steps can depend on the outputs of previous ones.

formats.name: Iterative Refinement
formats.description: A process designed to improve output quality through repeated cycles of generation, quality checking, issue identification, and refinement, as shown for 'Report generation'.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a loop that starts with an initial draft, followed by a quality check, identification of issues, and a refinement step that addresses those issues, repeating until a quality threshold is met.

formats.name: Context-Aware Tool Selection
formats.description: A pattern where the choice of tools or actions is dynamically determined based on the specific context or characteristics of the input, exemplified by 'Smart File Storage'.
formats.rebuild_hint: Utilize a decision tree or conditional logic to select the most appropriate tool or action based on input attributes such as file type, size, or specific user requirements.

formats.name: Domain-Specific Intelligence
formats.description: A pattern where specialized knowledge and rules, beyond general tool access, are applied to tasks within a particular domain, such as 'Financial compliance'.
formats.rebuild_hint: Integrate domain-specific rules, compliance checks, and specialized decision-making processes directly into workflows to handle complex, industry-specific tasks.

formats.name: AI-driven Lead Generation & Marketing Flow
formats.description: A multi-step automated process for high-ticket sales, specifically demonstrated for pool building. It involves identifying potential customers via satellite imagery, extracting public data, AI-rendering product visuals onto their property, calculating costs/value, generating personalized marketing materials (postcards, videos), and executing retargeting ad campaigns.
formats.rebuild_hint: 1. Scrape satellite imagery for target properties (e.g., homes without pools, empty backyards). 2. Filter properties based on criteria (lot size, sun exposure, recent ownership change). 3. Extract homeowner data from public records. 4. Use AI to render product visuals (e.g., a pool) onto the property's satellite image. 5. Calculate estimated cost and value lift for the upgrade. 6. Generate 'before and after' videos/images. 7. Create personalized direct mail (e.g., postcards with QR codes linking to videos). 8. Implement digital retargeting campaigns on social media platforms for those leads.

formats.name: Tweet with Embedded Data Visualization
formats.description: A social media post layout that combines textual information with a statistical bar chart for data representation.
formats.rebuild_hint: Utilize a standard social media card component. Integrate a text block for the post content and an image or embedded graph component for data visualization. Ensure clear attribution for the data source.

formats.name: AI Chat Input Flow
formats.description: A user interaction pattern for submitting queries to an AI chatbot, featuring a distinct input field with branding and a send action.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design an input field with a clear visual identity (e.g., AI logo). Implement text input functionality and a button to submit the query. Consider real-time typing animation for user feedback.

formats.name: AI Chat Interface
formats.description: A common layout for AI chat applications, featuring a central input field for user queries, a display area for conversation history, and often a sidebar for navigation or tool selection.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a flexbox or grid layout for the main container. Implement a fixed-position input bar at the bottom. Use a scrollable div for chat history. A left-aligned sidebar for tool/bot selection.

formats.name: AI Image Generation Workflow
formats.description: A workflow where a user inputs a text prompt and selects an art style, then the system generates one or more images based on these inputs.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a form with a textarea for description and a dropdown for style. Implement a 'Generate' button. Display generated images in a gallery or side-by-side comparison.

formats.name: AI Image Editing Workflow
formats.description: A workflow where a user uploads an image and then uses natural language prompts or predefined options to modify aspects like lighting, colors, details, hairstyles, outfits, or backgrounds.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create an image display area. Implement a chat-like input for editing commands. Provide quick-access buttons for common edits (e.g., 'Image Edit', 'Image Generation').

formats.name: AI Workspace Dashboard
formats.description: A dashboard layout designed to provide quick access to various AI tools and functionalities, often featuring a search bar and categorized tool listings.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a prominent search bar at the top. Arrange tool categories as horizontal cards or buttons. Consider a grid or list view for detailed tool listings.

formats.name: Neural Expressive Design Language
formats.description: A design language that dynamically builds new displays, layouts, and modals based on user prompts, creating a new visual UI in real-time.
formats.rebuild_hint: Utilize AI models to generate UI components, layouts, and interactive elements on the fly, adapting to user input and contextual information.

formats.name: iOS Share Sheet
formats.description: A system-level modal overlay that appears from the bottom of the screen, displaying a horizontal scrollable row of app icons (favorites) and a vertical list of other actions below. It includes options like AirDrop, messaging apps, and AI tools.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a bottom sheet modal with a horizontal UICollectionView for favorite app icons and a UITableView for additional actions, allowing customization of icon order and visibility.

formats.name: Android Share Sheet
formats.description: A system-level modal overlay that appears from the bottom of the screen, displaying a preview of the shared content at the top, followed by a grid of app icons for sharing actions. It allows pinning frequently used apps to the top row.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a bottom sheet modal with a content preview area at the top and a scrollable GridLayout or RecyclerView for app icons, supporting long-press for pinning functionality.

formats.name: Multi-Agent Attack Flow
formats.description: A conceptual flow illustrating a coordinated multi-agent attack on an AI model, involving decomposing queries, tracking context, and reassembling output to bypass safety filters. Visually represented by a central point expanding into a hexagonal network of nodes, then collapsing back.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a process where a complex task is broken into multiple sub-tasks (sub-queries), each handled by a separate agent or module. Implement context tracking to maintain coherence across these sub-tasks, and a final reassembly step to combine the results. Ensure each sub-task appears innocuous to bypass safety mechanisms.

formats.name: CLI Model Selection
formats.description: A command-line interface pattern for selecting options from a numbered list, often used for configuring tool behavior or AI models.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a text-based menu with numbered options. Capture user input for selection. Display descriptions for each option.

formats.name: CLI Conversation Log with Commands
formats.description: A terminal-style layout for displaying chat history, system messages, and command outputs, including error logs, in a sequential manner.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a fixed-width font and dark background. Implement a scrollable text area for history and a separate input line for commands. Format system messages and errors distinctly.

formats.name: Resume Experience Section (Bullet Points)
formats.description: A list of bullet points detailing work experience, often starting with action verbs and including quantifiable achievements.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use bullet points for each achievement. Start with a strong action verb. Quantify results (X) and explain how they were achieved (Y) and what action was taken (Z) using the Google X-Y-Z formula.

formats.name: Google X-Y-Z Formula
formats.description: A structured way to write resume bullet points: 'Accomplished X, as measured by Y, by doing Z'.
formats.rebuild_hint: For each achievement, identify the accomplishment (X), the measurable result (Y), and the action taken (Z). Combine them into a single, concise sentence.

formats.name: ATS Scan Results
formats.description: A structured output from an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) bot, highlighting problems with a resume's layout or content that might hinder automated parsing.
formats.rebuild_hint: Present findings with numbered problems, a clear problem statement, and reasons why an ATS would struggle (e.g., 'Graphic-heavy Canva-style resumes often use:').

formats.name: Interview Question & Answer Simulation
formats.description: A simulated interview where a bot acts as a hiring manager, asks technical questions, and then provides ideal answers based on a given background.
formats.rebuild_hint: Define the role and background. Generate specific technical questions. For each question, craft a detailed, relevant answer that leverages the provided background and experience.

formats.name: Cinematic follower flex edits
formats.description: A type of social media content showing an individual surrounded by a large, AI-generated crowd, implying a large follower count. It involves generating a stylized image and then animating it into a vertical video.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use an AI image generator to create a stylized image of a person surrounded by a crowd, then use an AI video generator to animate the image with camera movement and subtle crowd motion, formatted for social media.

formats.name: Research Paper Layout
formats.description: A standard academic paper layout featuring a title, date, icons for related platforms, an abstract-like description, a comparative bar chart, and a detailed benchmark table. Includes sections for getting started.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a clean, multi-section layout with clear headings. Use a combination of text, images, and tables to present information. Ensure good readability with appropriate typography and spacing.

formats.name: Comparative Bar Chart
formats.description: A bar chart comparing the performance scores of multiple AI models (GLM-5.1, GLM-5, GPT-5.4, Opus 4.6, Gemini 1.0 Pro) on 'Complex Software Engineering Tasks' (SWE-Bench Pro). Each bar is colored differently and displays its numerical score.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a charting library to create a bar chart. Clearly label the x-axis with model names and the y-axis with scores. Display numerical values on top of each bar for easy comparison. Use distinct colors for each bar.

formats.name: Hugging Face Model Card Layout
formats.description: A structured layout for presenting AI models on a platform like Hugging Face, including model name, organization, descriptive tags, and tabbed navigation for different aspects of the model (e.g., Model card, Files and versions, Community).
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a page with a prominent title and subtitle. Implement a tag system for categorization. Use a tabbed interface for organizing detailed information about the model, its files, and community discussions.

formats.name: Task List with Properties
formats.description: A structured list format where each item (task) has various associated properties and a dedicated section for an overview or sub-tasks.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a database or table structure with custom fields for properties and a rich text area for task overview. Implement filtering and sorting based on properties.

formats.name: Creative Asset Grid
formats.description: A grid-based display for visual assets, where each asset is represented by a card containing a thumbnail, title, and status indicator.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a responsive grid layout using CSS Grid or Flexbox. Each grid item should be a card component with an image/video placeholder, text overlay, and status badge.

formats.name: Chat Interface with Embedded Links and Lists
formats.description: A conversational interface allowing users to interact with an agent, where instructions can be provided as bulleted lists and include embedded hyperlinks.
formats.rebuild_hint: Develop a chat UI with message bubbles. Implement markdown rendering for lists and automatic detection/rendering of hyperlinks. Ensure bot messages are distinguishable from user messages.

formats.name: Batch Management Dashboard
formats.description: A dashboard for managing grouped items (batches) with status indicators and actions, allowing for bulk operations.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a main dashboard layout with collapsible sections for different batch types. Each batch item should display its name, status, and relevant actions (e.g., 'Launch'). Use a clear visual hierarchy for statuses.

formats.name: Ad Campaign Table
formats.description: A tabular display for managing advertising campaigns, showing key metrics and providing options for editing, duplicating, and previewing ads.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a data table component with sortable columns for metrics. Implement checkboxes for bulk selection and action buttons for common tasks like 'Edit' or 'Preview'. Include a search/filter bar.

formats.name: Ad Preview Modal
formats.description: A modal window for previewing ad creatives across different placements and versions.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a modal component that overlays the main content. Inside, display multiple ad previews (e.g., mobile feed, story) side-by-side or in a carousel. Include a dropdown for selecting different ad versions.

formats.name: Terminal Command Interface
formats.description: A command-line interface with a prompt, commands, and text-based output, including status messages and interactive prompts for model selection.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a terminal emulator, monospace font, and custom color scheme (dark background, colored text for different elements like commands, output, and status). Implement command parsing and output rendering.

formats.name: Model Listing with Tags
formats.description: A list of models, each with a name, description, and categorized tags (e.g., 'vision', 'tools', 'thinking', 'cloud', 'size'). Includes download/pull counts and update timestamps.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a grid or list layout. Each item should have a title, a short description, and a row of clickable/filterable tags. Include metadata like download counts and last updated date. Implement search and filtering.

formats.name: Software Download Page
formats.description: A page offering software downloads for different operating systems, with tabs for each OS, installation instructions (e.g., PowerShell command), and a prominent download button.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a tabbed interface for OS selection. Each tab should display relevant installation instructions (e.g., command line snippets) and a primary download button. Include system requirements.

formats.name: OODA Loop Framework
formats.description: A four-step decision-making cycle (Observe, Orient, Decide, Act) used for continuous learning and adjustment, particularly for problem-solving or strategy.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a cyclical process with distinct stages for observation, interpretation, decision-making, and action, with feedback loops.

formats.name: Four-Card Project Layout
formats.description: A layout featuring four distinct cards, each representing a project or category, with an icon, title, and descriptive text/examples.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a grid or flexbox to arrange four cards. Each card should have an icon, a bold title, and a list of bullet points or descriptive text. Use distinct background colors or borders for each card.

formats.name: Two-Column File Description Layout
formats.description: A layout presenting two distinct sections side-by-side, each detailing a 'file' or set of instructions with bullet points and examples.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a two-column grid or flexbox. Each column should contain a header, a list of bullet points, and an example text block. Use different background colors for each column to differentiate.

formats.name: Guided Setup Flow
formats.description: A step-by-step onboarding or setup process presented as a numbered checklist with titles, descriptions, and completion indicators.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a vertical list of numbered items. Each item includes a title, a brief description, and a visual indicator (e.g., a checkmark) for completion. Use a clear visual hierarchy for current vs. completed steps.

formats.name: Circular App Integration Diagram
formats.description: A diagram showing a central application connected to multiple external applications arranged in a circle around it.
formats.rebuild_hint: Place a central icon/logo. Arrange other application icons/logos in a circle around the central one, with lines or implied connections. Add a label for the external apps.

formats.name: Three-Column Feature Display
formats.description: A layout displaying three distinct features or options side-by-side, each with an icon, title, description, and an associated action.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a three-column grid or flexbox. Each column should contain an icon, a bold title, a descriptive paragraph, and a button or status indicator at the bottom.

formats.name: User Profile Update Form
formats.description: A UI pattern for updating user information, specifically an email address, demonstrating how a new value overwrites the old one in a 'current state only' database.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a simple form with a text input for email and an update button. Implement logic to replace the existing email with the new one upon submission.

formats.name: Event Stream Visualization
formats.description: A visual representation of a sequence of immutable events, showing how each event contributes to the current state of an entity. It includes event blocks and a derived current state box.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a timeline or flowchart using connected rectangular nodes for events and a separate node for the current state. Each event node should contain a description of the change.

formats.name: Side-by-Side Comparison Cards
formats.description: A layout pattern for comparing two different approaches or data representations (e.g., 'scoreboard' vs. 'play-by-play') using distinct, bordered cards.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a flexbox or grid layout to place two distinct card-like UI elements side-by-side. Each card should have a title, border, and content area to display comparative information.

formats.name: Agent Loop Pattern
formats.description: A reusable UI/layout pattern for an iterative agent process, starting with a user prompt, moving through context assembly, tool requests, permission checks, execution, and culminating in an assistant response.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design as a flowchart with a central loop. Use distinct blocks for each step and arrows to indicate flow. Include conditional branches for permissions and tool usage.

formats.name: Context Window Layering
formats.description: A structured display of different context types, organized into distinct layers (e.g., System, Project Config, Memory, Conversation, Runtime, On-Demand) to manage information for an AI agent.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use stacked, colored rectangular blocks for each layer. List specific context elements as sub-items within each layer.

formats.name: Circular AI Agent System Overview
formats.description: A conceptual layout showing a central AI component surrounded by a ring of supporting functions and data sources, illustrating the comprehensive ecosystem around an AI agent.
formats.rebuild_hint: Place a central icon for the AI. Arrange supporting components in a circle around it, connected by dashed lines to the center.

formats.name: European Map with Location Markers
formats.description: A stylized map of Europe in a metallic gold/bronze color, with small, light-colored human-like icons placed at various locations to denote supercomputing centers or AI factories.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a vector map of Europe, apply a metallic texture/gradient, and place custom icons at specific coordinates.

formats.name: Partner/Location List with Logos
formats.description: A vertical list of names, some accompanied by small logos, presented in white text against a dark background.
formats.rebuild_hint: A simple unordered list with text and inline image elements, styled with white text on a dark background.

formats.name: AI Infrastructure Growth Bar Chart
formats.description: A bar chart showing growth projection over years (2024, 2025, 2026) for 'GPU/Sh' with green bars. The 2025 bar is labeled '3X+' and the 2026 bar is significantly taller, implying '10X'.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a charting library (e.g., Chart.js, D3.js) to create a bar chart with a dark background, green bars, and specific labels for years and growth factors.

formats.name: Animated Stick Figures
formats.description: Simple, minimalist stick figures used to convey abstract concepts, interactions, and scenarios in a clear, relatable, and often humorous manner. They interact with text bubbles, objects, and other figures to illustrate points about AI and human skills.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use simple vector graphics for characters with basic shapes and colors. Employ minimal backgrounds and clear, legible text bubbles or labels to convey dialogue or concepts. Animate movements to be fluid but simple, focusing on conveying the idea rather than complex visuals.

formats.name: Comprehensive Content Strategy Document Layout
formats.description: A structured multi-page document format for a content strategy, including an executive summary, measurable targets, business context, detailed customer personas, and a content playbook.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a document with distinct sections for executive summary, targets (using tables), business context, persona descriptions, and content strategy details. Utilize clear headings and bullet points.

formats.name: Facebook Ad Creative Layout
formats.description: A standard Facebook ad layout comprising a main image, a headline, descriptive text, and a call-to-action button.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design an image with product and lifestyle elements. Overlay a clear headline and offer text. Include a prominent call-to-action button.

formats.name: Terminal-based AI Assistant
formats.description: An interactive command-line interface where an AI agent responds to natural language prompts, executes commands, plans tasks, writes code, and shows diffs, with features like model switching and command palettes.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a command-line interface using a terminal emulator, integrate with various AI models for natural language processing and code generation, display code diffs, and include keyboard shortcuts for navigation and commands.

formats.name: Operator Task Breakdown
formats.description: Visual representation of tasks handled by an operator: Strategy, Customer relationships, Distribution, Quality control.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use text labels connected by dashed lines to a central point representing the operator.

formats.name: Cost vs. Margins Graph
formats.description: A line graph illustrating how increasing costs lead to decreasing margins in traditional business models.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a 2D line graph with 'Cost' increasing and 'Margins' decreasing over time/scale.

formats.name: Solo Founder Tool Stack Cost Breakdown
formats.description: A visual breakdown of annual and monthly costs for a solo founder's AI tool stack.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use stacked bar charts or distinct text boxes to show different cost tiers (e.g., $3,000/year, $12,000/year, $200-$1,000/month).

formats.name: Progress Checklist
formats.description: A checklist component showing tasks with checkboxes and completion status.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a card with a title 'Progress' and a list of items with checkboxes, some checked, some unchecked.

formats.name: Outcome-Based Pricing Diagram
formats.description: Illustrates how automating a process saves money for the customer, allowing the product to capture a portion of that saved value.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use icons for 'company' and 'product box', connected by dashed lines, with money icons representing savings and captured value. Text overlays explain the win-win scenario.

formats.name: AI Correction Tracking List
formats.description: A numbered list displaying individual correction attempts for an AI, indicating success or failure and a maximum limit for corrections.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a list component with distinct styling for each item, including a number, text input, and a status icon (e.g., 'x failed'). Implement a counter and a visual limit indicator.

formats.name: AI Effectiveness Gauge
formats.description: A horizontal slider or progress bar visually representing the AI's performance or 'mood' (e.g., 'Working with you' vs 'Working against you'), with an indicator moving based on interaction outcomes.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a custom slider or progress bar with two labeled endpoints. An animated indicator (e.g., a sun icon) should move along the bar based on a calculated 'success rate' or 'failure count'.

formats.name: AI Context Window Display
formats.description: A dedicated window showing a list of 'wrong fixes' that are 'still loaded' in the AI's current context, highlighting accumulated errors.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a scrollable card or panel component. Inside, list items with a descriptive text (e.g., 'wrong fix - added a try/catch') and a status tag (e.g., 'still loaded').

formats.name: Clean Session Prompt Form
formats.description: A prompt input form designed for a 'clean session', including fields to incorporate specific learnings from previous failures (e.g., 'the constraint it missed', 'the file it ignored').
formats.rebuild_hint: Develop a multi-input form with a primary text area for the main prompt and additional, structured input fields for specific details or constraints learned from prior attempts.

formats.name: Sidebar Navigation
formats.description: A vertical navigation menu with distinct sections for chat and project-oriented work, allowing users to switch between modes and access features.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a vertical menu with clickable items, including icons and text labels, highlighting the active selection.

formats.name: Task-Oriented AI Interface
formats.description: An AI interface designed for managing tasks and projects, with specific options for scheduling, live artifacts, and dispatch, alongside a primary task input.
formats.rebuild_hint: Adapt the chat interface with project-specific navigation in the sidebar and task management features in the main content area.

formats.name: App Connector Grid
formats.description: A grid-based display of available applications for integration, with search and filter functionality, allowing users to easily add new connections.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a responsive grid for app cards, each with a name, description, and an 'add' button. Include a search bar and filter dropdowns at the top.

formats.name: Skill Instruction Form
formats.description: A form for defining custom AI skills with a name, description, and detailed instructions on how the skill should operate.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a modal or form with text input fields for skill name and description, and a larger textarea for detailed instructions.

formats.name: Business Proposal Document
formats.description: A structured business proposal format including key sections like vendor details, engagement scope, financial terms, project timeline, and client responsibilities.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a multi-section document layout with clear headings, bullet points, and tables for presenting detailed information in a professional manner.
